title: FunctionAtom
description: Atomic unit of analysis: one function/right/duty asserted by one clause.

atom_id.description: Stable id: sha1(doc_id + clause + predicate + object)[:12].

clause.description: Clause number exactly as printed, e.g. '5.6.3', '2.3.1ж', '3.4а'.

span.description: [start, end) character offsets in the normalized plain text of doc_id.

quote.description: Verbatim source text of the span. Never paraphrased.

subject.description: Who holds the function, as written (resolved to unit_id separately).

subject_unit_id.description: Resolved organizational unit or position, null if unassigned.

predicate.description: Normalized action verb from the ontology, e.g. 'контролировать', 'согласовывать'.

object.description: What the action applies to, normalized.

qualifier.description: Scope or periodicity narrowing the function, e.g. 'на ежеквартальной основе'. Part of identity, not noise.

modality.description: Strength of the norm. Ordered lattice: обязан > должен > осуществляется > может > вправе.

canonical_id.description: Cluster id shared by atoms expressing the same function across documents.

extraction.description: Provenance of the extraction, for reproducible replay.
